summaries.en: The U.S. and China are considering establishing a new, permanent trade commission to manage economic relations and disputes, reviving a formal dialogue channel abolished eight years ago, in preparation for a potential Trump-Xi summit.
summaries.zh: 美中两国正在考虑设立一个新的常设贸易委员会，以管理经济关系和贸易争端，这标志着在潜在的特朗普-习近平峰会之前，八年前废除的正式对话渠道将得到恢复。
